description.value: Dinerz — also known as Legendz Diner — is a fast-food diner situated on the Highway 1 Frontage Road in the Kootenays region of British Columbia, a corridor heavily travelled by touring cyclists. Its location on a highway frontage road makes it a logical stop for riders following the Trans-Canada route through the valley. The diner format suggests a sit-down or counter-service meal option in an area where food services can be sparse.
